dedupe_keys.name: foen bafu waste statistics for switzerland hazardous waste 1992 to 2024 imports and exports municipal waste and incinerator capacity series

description: These statistics describe how much waste Switzerland produces and how it is treated, with the longest series for hazardous waste. They are published by the Federal Office for the Environment (BAFU, FOEN). The page offers time series of hazardous waste arisings from 1992 to 2024, hazardous waste from 2012 to 2024 by disposal method, by waste group and by import and export country, other controlled wastes, municipal waste quantities from 1970, separate collections, combustible waste against incinerator capacity from 1996 to 2010, and waste used in cement kilns. Yearly sections add an overview of waste quantities and recycling, beverage packaging returns and hazardous waste statistics split into domestic treatment, imports and exports, and two overview images of the national disposal infrastructure and system. All files are free and available to download, mostly as PDF tables. Caveats: tables are in PDF, not machine-readable formats, several municipal series stop between 2010 and 2014, and results are national with no plant or canton breakdown. Simulation uses: setting national waste generation and treatment splits, sizing incineration and hazardous waste treatment capacity, and modelling cross-border hazardous waste flows. Related records: Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives comparable European totals, and the US RCRAInfo biennial report (data-epa-rcrainfo-biennial-report-hazardous-waste) is a facility-level hazardous waste counterpart.

schema_summary: Time series: hazardous waste arisings 1992-2024; hazardous waste 2012-2024 by disposal method and by waste group; hazardous waste imports and exports 2012-2024 (exports by country); other controlled wastes 2012-2024; municipal waste quantities 1970-2014; recycled and non-recycled municipal waste and separate collections 1970-2010; combustible waste and incinerator (KVA) capacity 1996-2010; cement kiln waste use 2005-2010; battery sales 2000-2010. Annual: waste quantities and recycling overview, beverage packaging, hazardous waste (domestic, import, export, summary), other notifiable wastes. Maps: disposal infrastructure and disposal system of Switzerland
